    (count(o.order_id))::integer AS order_count,
    (COALESCE(sum(o.amount), (<number>)::numeric))::numeric(<number>,<number>) AS order_amount
   FROM (public.departments d
     LEFT JOIN public.orders o USING (department_id))
  GROUP BY d.department_id;","definition public.patient_encounter_summary":" SELECT p.patient_id,

$function$
","definition public.patient_order_total(p_patient_id integer)":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.patient_order_total(p_patient_id integer)

$function$
